ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of this 4th day of November, 2020 (the “Effective Date"), Luis Figueroa, with an address at 2146 Honeywell Avenue, Bronx, NY, ("Seller"), and 2140 Honeywell LLC, a New York limited liability company with offices at 152 Madison Avenue, Suite 202, New York, NY 10016,“Developer") RECITALS: A. Seller is the Seller of certain land located at 2146 Honeywell Avenue, Bronx NY, Brooklyn, NY, also known as Tax Lot _46_ in Block _3125_on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings, as more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon existing as of the date hereof (said land being herein referred to as “Seller's Lands,” said improvements being herein referred to as referred to as “Seller's Property"). B. Developer is the fee Seller of, that certain property known as Tax Lot __48_ in Block _3125_("Block _3125") on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, (as more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Purchaser's Parcel"). C. Seller and Developer merge Seller's Land, and the “Purchaser's Parcel" into a single “zoning lot," as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (as amended to date and as the same may hereafter be amended, the “Zoning Resolution") (such single zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in

accordance with this Agreement or otherwise modified from time to time, being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot"). D. Accordingly, a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") dated the date hereof, with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot, will be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording at the Register. E. Seller's Land is contiguous with the “Purchaser's Parcel" for at least ten (10) linear feet, and the “Purchaser's Parcel" and Seller's Land are all within Block 3125. F. As used herein, the term “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean certain rights, as determined by the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, whereby such zoning lot may be developed by erecting thereon one or more structures with Floor Area determined by muitiplying the area of the zoning lot by the allowable Floor Area Ratio in that Zoning district."Floor Area" and “Floor Area Ratio" when used in this Agreement shall have the meaning ascribed to them in the Zoning Resolution. G.As used herein, the term “Excess Development Rights" shall mean (i) _8047 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Seller's Land as of the Effective Date (herein referred to as the "Excess Development Rights. H. Pursuant to procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution, Developer (and its successors and assigns) may from time to time transfer some or all of the Excess Development Rights to any Seller (including, itself) of any property within Block _3125 to which the Excess Development Rights may lawfully be transferred (any such property being herein referred to as “Developer's Land") so that “"Developer") may (but in no event shall be obligated to) renovate or construct a building or buildings and improvements upon Developer's Land or other land or lands within Block _3125_ (said new or renovated building or buildings
